# CANDIDATE: RSI_DIVERGENCE_BEARISH_STRUCTURE_BOS

**Filed:** 2026-09-10
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger

## Hypothesis

Bearish RSI divergence (price higher high, RSI lower low) coupled with a break of structure (BOS) to the downside yields a high‑probability short. This combination captures momentum exhaustion before structural breakdown, offering an edge in trending or choppy markets where pure structure breaks fail.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: Scan 5‑min bars for bearish RSI divergence — price makes a higher high (HH) over the last five bars while RSI makes a lower low (LH) over the same period. On the bar immediately following the divergence, if price breaks below the prior swing low (BOS) with close below that low, enter short at the close of the BOS bar. Exit: chart‑stop at the recent swing high used in the divergence calculation, TP1 at 1.5× risk (entry to stop), runner trailed by chandelier exit (ATR×3). Regime filters: VIX < 22, time 09:30‑12:00 EST, avoid FOMC/CPI/NFP windows.
